title: 高盛：并购市场活跃，IPO大门敞开
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I would say the tone in the boardroom is very much one of enthusiasm and confidence in deploying capital on M&A transactions and a particular desire to build scale in their core businesses.
segments.zh: 我认为董事会的氛围非常积极，对并购交易充满信心，特别希望在核心业务上扩大规模。

segments.en: So you're right. A year to date we're currently at $3.8 trillion in announced M&A volume.
segments.zh: 你说得对，年初至今，已公布的并购交易额已达3.8万亿美元。

segments.en: Importantly though it's been very much a strategic driven M&A market and that's been pronounced at the upper end of the M&A market. So if you look at the number of transactions north of 10 billion
segments.zh: 重要的是，并购市场一直由战略驱动，这在高端市场尤为明显。看看超过100亿美元的交易数量。

segments.en: dollars a year to date, we're at a record where at $49 so far this year. Now what is driving that?
segments.zh: 年初至今，已有49笔，创下纪录。那么是什么推动了这一趋势？

segments.en: I think there's a few factors. So one is and I'm sure we're going to talk about it as CEO resilience. I think they are more adept at dealing with uncertainty. The macro backdrop has held
segments.zh: 我认为有几个因素。一是CEO的韧性，他们更善于应对不确定性，宏观环境保持稳定。

segments.en: up so that leaves them confidence to lean in in deploying capital and there's a sense that they want to exploit their first mover advantage. So they want to maintain their competitive positioning
segments.zh: 这让他们有信心投入资本，并希望利用先发优势，通过并购保持竞争地位。

segments.en: and get ahead of their peers by doing M&A. But doesn't that in itself, sorry if I can interrupt for a second, suggest that there is this period of upheaval. If they feel they need to get out in front,
segments.zh: 但这本身是否意味着一个动荡时期？如果他们觉得需要抢先行动，所有这些事情都在发生。

segments.en: there's all these things happening. How much of it is, I don't want to say anxiety because clearly they're confident if they're doing these things but is it suggestive of a fast-changing
segments.zh: 其中有多少是——我不想说焦虑，因为他们显然有信心，但这是否暗示着快速变化的格局？

segments.en: landscape? I don't think it's anxiety. I think CEOs and corporates generally have just become much more adept at dealing with volatility and your term pressures. So if you take a step back,
segments.zh: 我不认为这是焦虑。我认为CEO和企业总体上更善于应对波动和周期性压力。退一步看。

segments.en: over the last several years they've had a lot of potential headwinds. So COVID and then the ensuing
segments.zh: 过去几年他们面临许多潜在阻力，比如新冠疫情及其后续影响。
